summary: One medium missing-dependency finding: the accepted map removes the valid SemisimpleAlgebras Layer 2 -> QuiverRepresentations Layer 3 edge in favour of an unreviewed research packet. alreadyRecorded is not merged, so the assembled atlas has neither this edge nor any dependency path between its endpoints. The five retained links, three scoped overlaps and their pinned-library qualifications withstand the checks described in the report.
checked: Independence: the original author was ChatGPT Pro cgp-7cf7c77d34d7 and the independent reviewer was Codex codex-hjdg0j; this red team is Codex codex-J6LwjP. Read the complete SemisimpleAlgebras source roadmap, accepted packet and independent review.

All five links: both endpoint quotations, supplier-to-consumer direction, coefficient and finiteness hypotheses, actual interface supplied, and the consumer obligations excluded by the reason. Checked the full CharacterTheory Layer 2, QuadraticFormInvariants Layer 5 and 7B consumer descriptions.

All three overlaps and the preserved Quiver dependency: read their endpoint descriptions; checked radical quotient versus lifting, simple-module versus semisimple-image bicommutant, and algebraic Brauer classes versus continuous H2. All eighteen evidence quotations are exact substrings of their named stage descriptions.

Pinned TauCeti f790474821cf4256814db967cb154e7af3d0c369 declaration statements and parameters: finite-dimensional radical API, scalar Schur, ringEquivEndEnd and centralizer_centralizer_range, tensor simplicity, linear Skolem-Noether, Brauer group operations and same-universe base change, finite splitting inside SeparableClosure, central real division-algebra classification and normalized real Brauer equivalence. No reviewed SemisimpleAlgebras entry exists in data/library-coverage.json; these are targeted source checks, not a complete library audit or Lean compilation.

Searched the summaries and stage descriptions of data/atlas.json and all nine new roadmap definitions: 221 roadmaps (220 active), 2028 stages, 149 stage hits for the semisimple/radical/Wedderburn/central-simple/Brauer/Skolem-Noether/bicommutant/isotypic/idempotent/Morita/division-algebra families. Read candidate contracts as described in the report; no additional exact supplier-consumer interface was established.

Compared every research link packet and promoted data/links packet for the Quiver ordered pair; inspected scripts/promote.py, scripts/build.py and scripts/decompositions.py. Independently assembled the production atlas and tested exact-edge and transitive reachability, then simulated restoration and duplicate restoration in memory.

Validated the accepted input with check_links.py (5 links, 3 overlaps, 217 examined, zero errors/warnings). The raw atlas plus all research links and all raw/new stage requires is acyclic (4501 distinct edges). The assembled atlas has 8007 edges; restoring the omitted edge produces 8008, passes cycle validation, and remains 8008 on repeated insertion.

findings.claim: The accepted packet drops a valid dependency from the live graph by deduplicating against an unreviewed research-only packet. SemisimpleAlgebras Layer 2 -> QuiverRepresentations Layer 3 is stored only in alreadyRecorded here and in links of the unreviewed Quiver packet. The claim that removing it removes no graph edge conflates the union of research proposals with the promoted atlas.
findings.evidence:
At input cc9d0f2a873a9ab218ad1b9474623364271aedb8, supplier tauceti:TauCetiRoadmap/RepresentationTheory/SemisimpleAlgebras#layer-2-artin-wedderburn-assembled-with-uniqueness says 'the
  chosen index is in bijection with isomorphism classes of simple `R`-modules (via Layer 1.5)'; consumer tauceti:TauCetiRoadmap/RepresentationTheory/QuiverRepresentations#layer-3-the-structure-of-a-finite-dimensional-algebra says 'and its Wedderburn decomposition indexes the simple
  modules; over `[IsAlgClosed k]` the blocks are matrix algebras over `k`. Consume
  [semisimple algebras](../SemisimpleAlgebras/README.md) for the Wedderburn side.'. The independent review says "Removing this proposal removes no graph edge" while acknowledging that the Quiver packet has no independent review. scripts/promote.py:decide skips a packet with no accepted review; build.py:assemble loads only data/links; decompositions.py:merge_links iterates packet.get("links", []), not alreadyRecorded. No promoted Quiver packet exists. assemble(require_distances=False) gives 2840 stages and 8007 stageEdges, both endpoints present, no exact edge, no requires entry, and no path from supplier to consumer. Restoring alreadyRecorded[0] as a link in memory adds exactly one edge and passes the cycle check; repeating the insertion adds evidence but no second edge. See the report for a reproduction.
findings.fix: Restore the scoped, two-sided-evidenced alreadyRecorded[0] dependency to this accepted packet's links, remove or rewrite its alreadyRecorded entry, and update the summary and corresponding review narrative to distinguish research proposals from promoted graph edges. Obtain the required independent acceptance/promotion of the corrected packet; changing research text alone does not update the existing promoted snapshot. Keep the present A/J(A) scope and the quiver-owned lifting/Morita obligations. Do not accept the unrelated Quiver packet wholesale. merge_links already deduplicates endpoint pairs, so later promotion of a reviewed Quiver packet will not duplicate the graph edge.
